label: Copy-phase reset unit for long sequences (L>=8), boosted by inputs f/o/z/j/x/3 and the second copied token
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, after the delimiter, never on original-phase or delimiter steps, and never when the input is a first occurrence. It depends heavily on length: zero for L<=5, rare for L=6-7, and 73% of activation mass is at L=9. Within long sequences it is strongest at recall_idx 2 (input = orig(1), 31% of mass) and again at the last two steps of L=9 sequences. The input token also matters: f, o, z and j have about 3x lift, and the top activations are f/o fed back at step L+2. Firing is diffuse and graded inside long copy phases, so many matching steps stay below threshold. The predicate reaches about 0.42 precision and 0.73 recall on dev.
